items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: It is Saturday, November 27, 2004. My name is William A Brauer Junior. I am at the home of Henry William Jones Junior conducting an interview for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Project. The engineer is Sven Abu. This is tape number two. I've read 17 years, and 20 years. But, what is the length of time that you were first in the studio, TV, radio, recording world?

It was less than 20 years because I wanted to join the 20-year club. You had to work there for 20 years to be like Specs Powell. It was just short of 20 years. It was something along the lines of 17 or maybe 19.
